texts.preamble: Aklima Begam vs Md. Nasim Siddiqul on 15 September, 2023 15.09.2023 Sl No.1 Court No.8 (gc) Crc 2 of 2023
texts.facts: An unregistered lease agreement appears to have been entered into between the alleged contemnor and one Shimla Restaurant Pvt. Ltd. is placed before this Court. In addition to this, fire licence and required licence issued under Food Safety and Standards Authority of India Act, 2006 have been disclosed. 2. It appears that before the interim order was passed, the lease agreement was entered into between the alleged contemnor and the said Restaurant. However, during the period when the interim order was not in operation, the other licences were obtained.
